evidence.description: Report number 25-076978, premises type residence, dated Thursday, May 1, 2025.
Responding officer began a scene examination on arrival at the residence.
A witness account was recorded. The witness's identity and content are not given in the text.
A resident who was home called 911, then locked themselves in a bathroom while the burglars took items. The burglars tried to enter the bathroom.
Purses and jewelry valued at more than 194,000 dollars reported taken, as stated at the scene. The value is a reported figure, not a verified one.
